note: utf8 is the descriptor as text; hex is the same bytes; sha256 is base64url (no padding) of SHA-256 over those bytes. Every valid vector was produced by two RFC 8785 canonicalizers that agree byte for byte.

valid.name: revoke two devices, targets sorted by deviceId
labels outside ASCII, a quote and a backslash (escaped by RFC 8785, nothing else is)
a label of exactly 40 code points
twenty devices, the most a descriptor names
the longest descriptor: twenty devices, each label 40 four-byte code points
remove-devices (a factor proof confirms it; never an email code)
remove-devices with no targets: finishing a rotation that is due

invalid.name: whitespace between tokens
invalid.why: not the canonical form (RFC 8785 emits no whitespace)

invalid.name: members out of order
invalid.why: not the canonical form (members sorted by UTF-16 code units)

invalid.name: a duplicate member
invalid.why: a duplicate member (I-JSON); its re-serialization differs

invalid.name: an escape RFC 8785 does not produce
a target with an extra member
invalid.why: a target is exactly { deviceId, label }

invalid.name: a device id with the wrong prefix
invalid.why: deviceId is dev_ and 26 Crockford symbols

invalid.name: a device id in upper case
a mailbox id that is not one
invalid.why: mailboxId is mbx_ and 26 Crockford symbols

invalid.name: an empty label
invalid.why: a label has 1 to 40 code points

invalid.name: a label of 41 code points
invalid.why: a label has 1 to 40 code points

invalid.name: a label with a control character
a label with a line separator
a label with a lone surrogate (written as an escape)
invalid.why: a lone surrogate (RFC 8785 refuses it; the bytes are not canonical either)

invalid.name: a nonce of 31 bytes
invalid.why: nonce is base64url of 32 bytes (43 characters)

invalid.name: issuedAt with a fraction
invalid.why: issuedAt is a whole number of seconds

attestations.note: Mail's checks, with the capability's sub and Mail's clock as given. `descriptor` names the valid vector whose digest Mail holds for its pending challenge.

accepted.name: the code was confirmed 50 seconds ago

refused.name: another account
refused.why: accountId must equal the capability's sub

refused.name: a kind an email code may not confirm
refused.why: an email code confirms only revoke-device

refused.name: another digest
refused.why: actionDigest must be the digest of the descriptor of Mail's pending challenge

refused.name: confirmed 301 seconds ago
refused.why: at is at most 300 seconds old

refused.name: confirmed in the future
refused.why: at is at most 5 seconds ahead of Mail's clock

refused.name: confirmed before the descriptor was issued
refused.why: at is not before the descriptor's issuedAt

refused.name: at as a string
refused.why: at is a whole number of seconds
